title: Self-Service Apps Kya Hain? Users Khud Kaam Karein, Load Kam
description: Self-service apps kya hain, kaun se 6 building blocks chahiye, design aur security ke rules, aur woh metrics jo batate hain app waqai kaam kar raha hai.
hero_caption: अच्छा self-service app उपयोगकर्ता से वही पूछता है जो ज़रूरी है — बाकी सब खुद संभालता है
